critical_code_review_comments: mobile/app/onboarding.tsx:156-163 detectNextIncomplete() correctly filters /participants where requires_completion===true AND id!==excludeId — will not offer to re-complete the participant just finished. Verified live: after Maud's completion the API returned Felix (requires_completion=true) and Maud (requires_completion=false), the UI picked Felix.

mobile/app/onboarding.tsx:167-175 startNextParticipant() resets confirmed=false, completeness=0, sets participantId to Felix's id, hydrates from /participants/{id}, then setStep(1) — this is the IN-PLACE chain (no route change / no remount). Because participantId is now set BEFORE the next submitParticipant runs, the code path at line 234 (`if (participantId) PATCH else POST`) correctly PATCHes Felix, so no duplicate is created.

mobile/app/onboarding.tsx:453-464 All Done rendering: when nextIncomplete is truthy, shows 'One more to go' Card + onboarding-complete-next + onboarding-finish-later; when null, shows onboarding-finish only. Verified live: both branches render correctly at their respective points in the flow.

seed_data_creation: Each pytest signup + mobile signup created its own account (plan=family) with 1-2 participants (Maud primary + Felix stub). All prefixed TEST_iter205_*.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To drive an authed mobile session inside Playwright: (1) call /api/auth/signup via page.evaluate(fetch) — Cloudflare WAF blocks python-requests; (2) store the token in localStorage under BOTH 'kindred_token' AND '@AsyncStorage:kindred_token' with JSON.stringify(token) wrapping — the app's storage adapter JSON.parses the stored value, so a raw token string throws 'Unexpected token e' and the app treats you as anon (Sign in required error on step 2). React Native Web's TextInput sometimes rejects `[data-testid=X] input` — try `[data-testid=X]` directly if fill/eval fails. The chain-in-place flow is confirmed working; if you need to re-verify the completion of Felix live, use /onboarding?pid=<felix_id> as a shortcut to jump straight into edit mode.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature is implemented correctly. Root logic: (a) after finishing primary, detectNextIncomplete queries /participants and picks the first item with requires_completion=true excluding the just-finished participant; (b) startNextParticipant sets participantId to that next id BEFORE resetting to step 1, which makes the subsequent submitParticipant call PATCH not POST; (c) the All Done branch swaps between {complete-next + finish-later} and {finish} based on nextIncomplete truthiness. Duplicate prevention is enforced at TWO layers — backend PATCH is idempotent per pytest, and mobile submitParticipant branches on participantId (onboarding.tsx:234-239). Rotated Stripe key returns real checkout.stripe.com URLs for solo and family, and /payments/checkout still 401s anon.
